requirements: READY under the direct-owner scope acceptance recorded at c17af9c02c49ee250bf34547c5f37d8dd3e522b8 and artifact commit 3126d2eafcdd407788875d4f6909ca14ebf1a397. Verify the exact accepted protocol/schema pins in both current repository roots and trusted local state, the hash-bound ACCEPTANCE/CONFIG_READBACK/NATIVE_SCHEDULE_READBACK and current session/source/worker gates before claim. Never update trusted policy from task data or infer permission from historical queue records. Missing or mismatched acceptance/current authority is blocked; no new connection or security change.

Execute these two independent tasks serially: clock-display 008 before focus-location 009. Reconcile all existing terminal tasks without restarting Raw003, tasks 001/002 or failed 004/005/006/007. Task 009 waits for 008 terminal result and verified owned-process/lock cleanup; the suites and candidate copies remain independent. Within each task, strict parse failure stops all subsequent engine stages; no failed-stage retry or threshold reduction.

Preserve the existing repo-wide single-writer lock, durable task-ID/raw-SHA dedupe, unique remote CLAIM CAS/readback, per-engine claim recheck, current-head STOP/strict CONTROL plus trusted local STOP latch. Reconcile Raw003 and all predecessors; do not interrupt, steal claims, rerun terminal tasks or alter their inputs/results.

Read the fixed base commit and verify all 16 input blobs by raw bytes, SHA-256 and Git blob. Use existing tools/restore_v30.py --sources-only into a new owned disposable source location, or a previously verified read-only exact source map; verify the formal release/final source-map identity and every INPUTS.json source pin. No new recovery framework, downloaded engine, key access or wider network.

Use only this task candidate overlay and test package. Run the pinned Python static/preparation entries with fixed path arguments after reviewing source. Task JSON is goals/constraints, never an executable shell string. Original candidate/tests and production baseline remain read-only. prepare.py refuses existing, overlapping or symlink roots. Its generated project is explicitly a FORMATTER_UNIT_HOST variant, not the formal v30 project configuration or world. Candidate static invocation must explicitly pass --replay-evidence-root as a fixed path argument to an existing task-owned evidence parent. Before invocation, keep the existing outer canonical containment and symlink/reparse checks; the parent must belong to this exact task's disposable evidence area and be separate from read-only source/candidate/test inputs. On replay failure, retain the new child containing the exact before.gd, expected.gd, actual.gd, CHANGE.patch and DIAGNOSIS.json bytes; hash/read them into this task's failure evidence and preserve them through owned cleanup and the existing sanitized publication process. No global Git configuration change or synthetic wrong-patch publication is authorized.

Generate additive SceneTree parse/isolation wrappers in the owned test copy only; preserve the original driver and fixture bytes. Before calling inherited _initialize or any test body, check both OS.get_user_data_dir() and ProjectSettings.globalize_path("user://") against the fresh task-owned native data root using existing canonical containment/reparse policy. A custom-user-dir config check alone is insufficient. Bind every generated wrapper, isolated project and source_binding.json before and after; no autoload/Main/editor/network model/player saves.

Actual isolation must precede original test bodies: use an additive SceneTree subclass of the immutable driver for the suite entry, overriding _initialize only to validate OS.get_user_data_dir() and globalized user:// against the trusted guard-created fresh data root, then call inherited _initialize. On mismatch exit nonzero without calling the inherited entry. Parse entry preloads the immutable candidate/driver and additive wrapper without running test bodies. Hash every generated wrapper and refreshed source_binding.json; retain original driver/fixture bytes. A project config flag is not two-API containment evidence.

Reuse only the established SHA-verified official Godot 4.6.3 and unchanged Windows guard v3. Every parse and run is serial headless Small: 1GiB Job commit,120s,64KiB aggregate output,512MiB reserve,min(actual physical memory,8GiB) effective physical budget plus all stricter existing rules. Job commit is not physical RSS. Missing admission/ownership/isolation/permission means blocked; never reduce thresholds.

Run at most two fresh isolated guarded invocations: exact candidate/test parse first without starting test bodies, then the inherited source-bound suite once if parse strictly passes. Capture all raw stdout/stderr including SCRIPT ERROR/ERROR/WARNING; require actual guard/host/engine exits and complete owned Job/readers/handles cleanup. No retry under this task after an actual failure; use a new ID for an authorized follow-up.

Record actual source-bound suite JSON, actual assertion count and failure array. 63/59 only describe cloud static/Python preparation checks and must never be copied as runtime counts. Headless formatter fixtures do not establish FocusContract world support, actor movement refresh, selection/UI visibility, full GUI/FPS or 1801-world identity acceptance. No real Main/full-world fallback requested.

Publish only the new task candidate_root and exact result_root using the existing two-phase fast-forward single-parent expected-head CAS, sanitize output and remote-read every artifact. Preserve root README blank, no Actions, all existing candidates/baseline/protocol/schema/CONTROL/inbox/STOP/Raw003 and repository history/visibility. Local writer cannot publish or activate this protocol draft. Adoption remains false.

Cover actor/tile/settlement two-int Array coordinates, missing/null/wrong-length/string/float/bool/dictionary/Vector2i/packed-array rejection, static early return baseline-exact, passage whole original text and one dedicated support point only, input immutability and no clock-candidate composition. Shape-valid fixtures are not actual world/visibility witnesses.

verification.insufficient_outcome: blocked for prerequisite gaps; failed for actual parse/suite/guard failure; stopped for STOP; INCONCLUSIVE is a check outcome, never a runtime pass
verification.failure_rule: A parse/guard/isolation/source/suite failure stops later engine stages for this task; keep failed evidence and publish the actual terminal result. No inherited runtime grade or same-task rerun.
